reason: settleDocumentDrafts is defined at src/corpus/read-on-add.ts:133 and a git grep at 46635c5 finds only the test calling it. No route, CLI or migration calls it, so drafts drawn from client documents before this commit stay 'draft'.

readBounties always calls currentRound, which inserts a bounty_round row whenever one is due, so side reads can open a round. Opening a round lazily on read is the stated design, and the round chosen is the same, so the only effect is when the round gets fixed.

currentRound's queries are awaited inside readBounties with no catch, and several callers do not catch either. However, readBounties already ran many unguarded queries before this commit, so the change only adds one more DB failure point.

readBountyHistory takes the note of the latest enquiry_movement and historyBody renders it to clients as 'The answer'. Moves made through the strategist-only move_enquiry tool or the CLI carry a strategist's or Ed's free-text note, which then appears in the client's History.

acceptAttempt runs only when a branch reruns within the same run; a branch reruns only when its stage is not complete, and scoring/presentation run only after derivation completes, so an incomplete branch has no scored or shown insights to supersede. The earlier_attempt reason is recorded.

retireIfShown supersedes any original not already superseded or merged, including rejected ones. clientInsightSql shows a superseded insight when no later version is released, so a rejected insight reappears to the client while its rerun waits for release.

When the ceiling binds, runVerificationStage saves 'truncated' and rethrows; retryWaitingScoring catches it, marks the checks 'deferred' and skips presentation. A truncated verification is never treated as passed.

The archive route only sets archived_at and never unschedules; ensureSchedules registers crons at worker start and removes nothing, and no cycle code checks archived_at. A company archived after its cron was registered keeps getting scheduled cycles.

confirmDraft stores the plan's asks with origin 'plan_derivation'. Bounties count a directed_question only when origin='conversation'. syncPlanEnquiries, called on every config save, deactivates plan_derivation rows not in the plan's hypotheses or indicators. Research spawning takes any open directed_question without a domain.

typicalRunMs('derivation') takes the median of every complete run with stage_scope 'derivation'. Single-insight recomputes and batch reruns also create such runs, so their much shorter durations go into the analysis ETA.

readResearchTopics(...).catch(() => null) swallows the error without logging and leaves states empty; planStatus then returns 'Did not start'. The behaviour is as claimed but only on a DB read failure.
In fetchBrand, an unusable or failed read upserts colour, logo_url and fonts as null with source 'default', overwriting the website-derived brand stored before until a later successful read.

79ad551 edits the already-committed migrations/123_company_brand.sql; the runner skips any file already in schema_migrations, so a database that applied 123 earlier never gets the new columns. Fresh databases are correct; whether any other database applied the earlier version cannot be seen from the code.

research_act builds its path from the tool's resolved subject slug, and pageActionFor refuses any path not under the chat's own subject; the request then runs through the page's own route checks. An action cannot target another company's scope.
